```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =========================================================
# Urban within-unit vs between-unit microbiome sharing
# NEGATIVE CONTROL
#
# R Markdown version for RStudio
# - Reads exported QIIME2 feature-table.tsv directly
# - No qiime2R required
# - No biom command required
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Package check
# ---------------------------------------------------------
required_pkgs <- c("vegan", "ggplot2")

for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(vegan)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(1)
```

# 1. User parameters

```{r parameters}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# This script uses the GU-level negative-control dataset.
# Therefore, use:
#   sharing feature table
#   sharing metadata
#
# If your actual folder is "inputs" instead of "input",
# change "input/" to "inputs/" below.
# ---------------------------------------------------------

asv_table_path <- "inputs/exported_sharing_table/feature-table.tsv"
metadata_path  <- "inputs/sharing_meta.txt"

# Metadata column settings
sample_id_col <- NA        # NA = auto-detect
unit_col      <- "Region"  # gu code column, e.g. A..L

# Data-processing parameters
table_features_as_rows <- TRUE
min_unit_n  <- 5
do_rarefy   <- TRUE
min_depth   <- NA

# Presence/absence thresholds
thresholds  <- c(0.001, 0.0005, 0.0001)
primary_thr <- 0.001

# Statistics
n_perm <- 999
seed   <- 1

# Output directory
out_dir <- "results"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Figure settings
fig_width  <- 4.2
fig_height <- 4.6
fig_dpi    <- 600

within_col  <- "#4E79A7"
between_col <- "#BDBDBD"

set.seed(seed)
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
read_tsv_table <- function(path, features_as_rows = TRUE) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Feature table not found: ", path)
  }

  first <- readLines(path, n = 1)

  # QIIME2/BIOM exported TSV usually starts with:
  # # Constructed from biom file
  skip <- if (grepl("^# Constructed", first)) 1L else 0L

  df <- read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    skip = skip,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  m <- as.matrix(df)
  storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"

  if (!features_as_rows) {
    m <- t(m)
  }

  return(m)
}

read_metadata <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Metadata file not found: ", path)
  }

  lines <- readLines(path)

  # Remove QIIME2 metadata type row if present
  lines <- lines[!grepl("^#q2:types", lines)]

  con <- textConnection(lines)
  on.exit(close(con))

  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cliffs_delta <- function(a, b) {
  gt <- 0
  lt <- 0

  for (x in a) {
    gt <- gt + sum(x > b)
    lt <- lt + sum(x < b)
  }

  (gt - lt) / (length(a) * length(b))
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("NA")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

nature_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 4)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9.5,
        hjust = 0,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 10.5,
        margin = margin(r = 7)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 10,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9.5,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.45,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.4,

      ),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2.2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
    )
}

save_plot_all <- function(plot, filename_base, width, height, dpi = 600) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in"
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi
  )

  if (requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".svg")),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = "in",
      device = svglite::svglite
    )
  }
}

analyze_threshold <- function(relab, units, thr, n_perm = 0) {
  pa <- (relab >= thr) * 1L

  keep_s <- rowSums(pa) > 0

  if (any(!keep_s)) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "thr=%.4f: dropping %d empty sample(s)",
      thr,
      sum(!keep_s)
    ))

    pa <- pa[keep_s, , drop = FALSE]
    units <- units[keep_s]
  }

  pa <- pa[, colSums(pa) > 0, drop = FALSE]

  jac_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(vegdist(pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE))

  idx <- which(upper.tri(jac_sim), arr.ind = TRUE)

  i <- idx[, 1]
  j <- idx[, 2]
  sim <- jac_sim[idx]

  u1 <- units[i]
  u2 <- units[j]

  is_w <- u1 == u2

  per_unit_within <- tapply(sim[is_w], u1[is_w], mean)

  bw <- !is_w

  pk <- ifelse(
    u1[bw] < u2[bw],
    paste(u1[bw], u2[bw], sep = "__"),
    paste(u2[bw], u1[bw], sep = "__")
  )

  per_pair_between <- tapply(sim[bw], pk, mean)

  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(
    per_unit_within,
    per_pair_between,
    alternative = "greater"
  ))

  cl <- cliffs_delta(
    as.numeric(per_unit_within),
    as.numeric(per_pair_between)
  )

  stat_obs <- median(per_unit_within) - median(per_pair_between)

  pu <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(names(per_pair_between), "__"))

  excess <- sapply(names(per_unit_within), function(U) {
    inv <- pu[, 1] == U | pu[, 2] == U
    per_unit_within[U] - mean(per_pair_between[inv])
  })

  perm_p <- NA

  if (n_perm > 0) {
    ps <- numeric(n_perm)

    for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {
      sp <- sample(units)

      s1 <- sp[i]
      s2 <- sp[j]

      wp <- s1 == s2

      wm <- tapply(sim[wp], s1[wp], mean)

      k <- ifelse(
        s1[!wp] < s2[!wp],
        paste(s1[!wp], s2[!wp], sep = "__"),
        paste(s2[!wp], s1[!wp], sep = "__")
      )

      bm <- tapply(sim[!wp], k, mean)

      ps[p] <- median(wm) - median(bm)
    }

    perm_p <- (sum(ps >= stat_obs) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  }

  list(
    threshold = thr,
    per_unit_within = per_unit_within,
    per_pair_between = per_pair_between,
    excess = excess,
    n_units = length(per_unit_within),
    n_units_pos_excess = sum(excess > 0),
    median_within = median(per_unit_within),
    median_between = median(per_pair_between),
    excess_overall = stat_obs,
    wilcox_p = w$p.value,
    cliffs_delta = cl,
    perm_p = perm_p
  )
}
```

# 3. Load feature table and metadata

```{r load-data}
feat <- read_tsv_table(
  asv_table_path,
  features_as_rows = table_features_as_rows
)

meta <- read_metadata(metadata_path)

dim(feat)
head(meta)
```

# 4. Match sample IDs

```{r match-samples}
# Auto-detect sample-id column
if (is.na(sample_id_col)) {
  cand <- c(
    "sample_id",
    "sample-id",
    "sampleid",
    "SampleID",
    "#SampleID",
    "id",
    "ID"
  )

  hit <- cand[cand %in% colnames(meta)]

  if (!length(hit)) {
    stop(paste0(
      "Could not auto-detect the sample-id column. Set sample_id_col manually. Metadata columns: ",
      paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  sample_id_col <- hit[1]
  message("Using sample-id column: ", sample_id_col)
}

if (!(unit_col %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop(paste0(
    "unit_col '",
    unit_col,
    "' not found. Metadata columns: ",
    paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

meta <- data.frame(
  sample_id = trimws(as.character(meta[[sample_id_col]])),
  unit = trimws(as.character(meta[[unit_col]])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(feat) <- trimws(colnames(feat))

common <- intersect(colnames(feat), meta$sample_id)

if (!length(common)) {
  stop("No overlapping sample IDs between feature table and metadata.")
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Samples table = %d\nMetadata samples = %d\nOverlap = %d\n",
  ncol(feat),
  nrow(meta),
  length(common)
))

feat <- feat[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(common, meta$sample_id), ]

head(meta)
```

# 5. Filter small units and prepare count table

```{r filter-units}
un <- table(meta$unit)
keep_u <- names(un)[un >= min_unit_n]

cat(sprintf(
  "Units before = %d\nUnits after min_unit_n >= %d = %d\n",
  length(un),
  min_unit_n,
  length(keep_u)
))

sel <- meta$unit %in% keep_u

feat <- feat[, sel, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[sel, ]

counts <- t(feat)
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]

table(meta$unit)
```

# 6. Rarefaction

```{r rarefaction}
depth <- rowSums(counts)

cat(sprintf(
  "Library size: min = %d, median = %d, max = %d\n",
  min(depth),
  as.integer(median(depth)),
  max(depth)
))

if (do_rarefy) {
  target <- if (is.na(min_depth)) {
    min(depth)
  } else {
    as.integer(min_depth)
  }

  low <- depth < target

  if (any(low)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "Dropping %d sample(s) below depth %d\n",
      sum(low),
      target
    ))

    counts <- counts[!low, , drop = FALSE]
    meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]
  }

  counts <- rrarefy(counts, sample = target)

  cat(sprintf("Rarefied to even depth = %d\n", target))
}

un <- table(meta$unit)
keep_u <- names(un)[un >= min_unit_n]
sel <- meta$unit %in% keep_u

counts <- counts[sel, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[sel, ]

cat(sprintf(
  "FINAL: %d samples across %d units\n",
  nrow(counts),
  length(unique(meta$unit))
))

table(meta$unit)
```

# 7. Convert to relative abundance

```{r relative-abundance}
relab <- sweep(counts, 1, rowSums(counts), "/")
units_vec <- meta$unit

dim(relab)
```

# 8. Run primary analysis and threshold sensitivity

```{r run-analysis}
res <- analyze_threshold(
  relab = relab,
  units = units_vec,
  thr = primary_thr,
  n_perm = n_perm
)

scan <- lapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  analyze_threshold(
    relab = relab,
    units = units_vec,
    thr = t,
    n_perm = 0
  )
})

names(scan) <- sprintf("%.4f", thresholds)

ep <- res$excess

scan_cor <- sapply(scan, function(s) {
  suppressWarnings(cor(
    ep,
    s$excess[names(ep)],
    method = "spearman"
  ))
})

scan_tab <- data.frame(
  threshold = thresholds,
  median_within = sapply(scan, function(s) s$median_within),
  median_between = sapply(scan, function(s) s$median_between),
  excess = sapply(scan, function(s) s$excess_overall),
  wilcox_p = sapply(scan, function(s) s$wilcox_p),
  cliffs_delta = sapply(scan, function(s) s$cliffs_delta),
  n_units_pos_excess = sapply(scan, function(s) s$n_units_pos_excess),
  n_units = sapply(scan, function(s) s$n_units),
  spearman_excess_vs_primary = scan_cor,
  row.names = NULL
)

scan_tab
```

# 10. Plot: within-gu vs between-gu sharing

```{r plot-within-between, fig.width=4.2, fig.height=4.6}
plot_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    group = "intra",
    value = as.numeric(res$per_unit_within) * 100,
    id = names(res$per_unit_within),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    group = "inter",
    value = as.numeric(res$per_pair_between) * 100,
    id = names(res$per_pair_between),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

plot_df$group <- factor(
  plot_df$group,
  levels = c("inter", "intra")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# P-value label
# 원본 분석은 within > between 단측 Wilcoxon이지만,
# 네 예시 스타일은 two-sided Wilcoxon이므로 plotting용으로 별도 계산
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_p <- suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(
    value ~ group,
    data = plot_df,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )$p.value
)

p_label <- paste0("P = ", formatC(plot_p, format = "e", digits = 2))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bracket 위치 자동 계산
# ---------------------------------------------------------
y_max <- max(plot_df$value, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min <- min(plot_df$value, na.rm = TRUE)
y_rng <- y_max - y_min

bracket_y <- y_max + y_rng * 0.10
text_y    <- bracket_y + y_rng * 0.025

y_upper <- text_y + y_rng * 0.06

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_within_between <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)
) +
  geom_violin(
    width = 0.82,
    trim = FALSE,
    scale = "width",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.82
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.70,
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.75,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = bracket_y,
    yend = bracket_y,
    linewidth = 0.65,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = text_y,
    label = p_label,
    size = 3.0,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "inter" = "#D9D9D9",
      "intra" = "#F29A9A"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(NA, y_upper),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall mean ASV sharing rate",
    subtitle = "Statistics: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test; P shown",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean ASV Sharing rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10.5,
      face = "bold",
      color = "black",
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      color = "grey35"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      color = "grey35"
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey90"
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey88"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.30,
      color = "grey92"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  )

p_within_between
```

# 12. Primary result summary

```{r summary}
cat("\n================ PRIMARY RESULT ================\n")
cat(sprintf("Threshold                     : %.4f\n", primary_thr))
cat(sprintf("Units                         : %d\n", res$n_units))
cat(sprintf("Median within-gu Jaccard      : %.4f\n", res$median_within))
cat(sprintf("Median between-gu Jaccard     : %.4f\n", res$median_between))
cat(sprintf("Excess, within - between      : %.4f\n", res$excess_overall))
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon, within > between P  : %.3g\n", res$wilcox_p))
cat(sprintf("Cliff's delta                 : %.3f\n", res$cliffs_delta))

if (!is.na(res$perm_p)) {
  cat(sprintf("Permutation P                 : %.3g\n", res$perm_p))
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Units with positive excess    : %d / %d\n",
  res$n_units_pos_excess,
  res$n_units
))

cat("\nThreshold sensitivity:\n")
print(scan_tab, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nInterpretation note:\n")
cat("This is a negative-control urban contrast. A small or non-significant within-gu excess is expected.\n")
cat("Compare excess and Cliff's delta to the rural village result, not the absolute Jaccard value.\n")
```
